transforms.code: return value.showBar or value.text or None is not None

config.script:
counterInfo = self.view.custom.assetCounters.selectedData[0] if len(self.view.custom.assetCounters.selectedData) == 1 else None
	if counterInfo is None: return

	msg = "Are you sure you want to delete this counter?"
	system.perspective.openPopup("UserConfirmPopup", "kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm",  {'text':msg, 'messageHandler':'deleteCounterMsg', 'inputPayload': {'counterInfo': counterInfo}}, title='Delete Counter', modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)
#	self.view.getChild("root").deleteCounter(counterId)
	
	return

customMethods.name: openCounterEditor
customMethods.script:
values = self.view.custom
	if len(values['assetCounters']['selectedData']) > 0: counterInfo = values['assetCounters']['selectedData'][0]
	else: counterInfo = {"tagPath": None, "assetId": values['assetInfo']['assetId'], "assetPath": None, "counterTypeId": None, "counterTypeName": None, "tagPathDisplay": None, "udtType": None, "counterId": None, "counterName": None}

	system.perspective.openPopup('Counter Editor', 'kanoa/mes/config/counters/assetCountEditor', {'value': {'counterInfo': counterInfo}}, title= 'Counter Editor', draggable=True, showCloseIcon=True)
	
	return

customMethods.name: deleteCounter
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("deleteCounter() called with %s"%counterInfo)
	success, msg = system.kanoa.asset.deleteCounter(counterInfo['counterId'], self.view.custom.security.userId)
	if not success: system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': 'Unable to delete counter. %s'%msg})
	else:
		if counterInfo['tagPath']:
			parentTagPath = counterInfo['tagPath'].rsplit('/', 1)[0]
			retVals = system.tag.deleteTags([parentTagPath])
			system.perspective.print("system.tag.deleteTags() called with %s returned %s"%(counterInfo['tagPath'], retVals))
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Counter has been deleted.'})
	
	self.clearAssetCounterSelection()
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assetCounters.data")
	
	return
